summary: Minimal agent-neutral governance foundation completed. Created .governance/ directory structure with SYSTEM.md, RULES.md, SAFETY.md, and REVIEW_POLICY.md. Established tool-neutral governance contracts and safety policies for Ralph-Loop system.

Started RALPH-002A: Minimal runtime-state and handoff foundation. Creating static runtime foundation files for task state management, handoffs, runs, validation, and reporting without implementing runtime behavior.

RALPH-002A completed: Minimal runtime-state and handoff foundation. Created all required static foundation files including task-state.json, task-history.jsonl, runs/current-run.json, validation-rules.json, and morning-review.md template. JSON and JSONL validation passed, no code/runtime behavior changed.

Started RALPH-003A: Minimal agent prompt and adapter contracts. Creating static prompt templates and adapter contracts for Cline, OpenCode, Roo, and Codex. No executable adapters or loop-runner scripts - static contract foundation only.

RALPH-003A completed: Minimal agent prompt and adapter contracts. Created static prompt templates (coordinator, worker, reviewer, validator) and adapter documentation (cline, opencode, roo, codex) plus configuration files (loop-config, protected-files). JSON and JSONL validation passed, no executable adapters or runtime behavior changed.

RALPH-004A completed: Root governance transition notes. Added minimal transition notes to SSOK.md and AGENTS.md explaining Ralph-Loop governance migration. Created comprehensive transition documentation in docs/RALPH_LOOP_TRANSITION_NOTES.md. Updated runtime state files. No product code or scripts changed.

Started RALPH-005A: Dry-run task selector plan. Creating comprehensive planning document for deterministic task selection algorithm. Defining CLI interface, eligibility rules, safety constraints, and implementation specifications for future dry-run selector script.

RALPH-005A completed: Dry-run task selector plan. Created comprehensive implementation plan with CLI interface, task eligibility rules, safety constraints, JSON schema definitions, and error handling specifications. Plan document provides complete implementation guide for RALPH-006A.

Started RALPH-006A: Dry-run task selector implementation. Implementing the first executable Ralph-Loop component based on RALPH-005A plan. Creating deterministic task selector script with CLI interface, safety checks, and dry-run capabilities.
